about.title: About
about.body: I'm Chuah Wen Han, a Computer Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) graduate from UCSI University (CGPA 3.90, Dean's List every eligible semester) and currently a Graduate Talent on Intel's ECG AI & Cloud Remote Solutions Engineering team. My core strength is the AI layer and the infrastructure underneath it: designing agentic LLM systems, building retrieval pipelines on vector databases, exposing expert tooling to models through MCP, and deploying and scaling all of it on Azure with proper auth, observability and CI/CD. Frontend is a means to an end for me — the depth is in making AI systems reliable, secure and fast in production.

jobs.role: Graduate Talent — ECG AI & Cloud Remote Solution Engineer
jobs.description: Full-stack AI engineer delivering cloud-based automation and enterprise AI services. Built end-to-end AI pipelines (data ingestion, retrieval, model integration and APIs) and deployed and scaled services on Azure, handling backend engineering, SQL/NoSQL database design, system integration and Git-based CI/CD.
highlights: Architected an enterprise Agentic RAG platform routing requests across domain-specific AI agents.
Built an MCP server exposing WinDbg kernel debugging as LLM tools, encoding 19+ bugcheck playbooks.
Delivered a ReAct autonomous agent with SSH execution, safety validation and human-in-the-loop approval.

jobs.description: Developed an AI-powered image-to-text model using OpenCV, OCR and deep learning. Designed and optimized shape, line and text detection to automate flowchart analysis, integrated it with an LLM for AI-driven query responses, and deployed the system with Docker and Flask.
highlights: Image-to-text pipeline combining OpenCV, OCR and deep learning for automated flowchart analysis.
Integrated with an LLM for AI-driven query responses; shipped with Docker + Flask.

jobs.description: Built deep-learning models for machine-vision systems using PyTorch and YOLOv8. Implemented instance segmentation for product defect inspection and size measurement, covering research, model architecture design, training and performance evaluation.
highlights: YOLOv8 instance segmentation for product defect inspection and size measurement.
Owned research, architecture design, training and evaluation end to end.

projects.title: Projects

items.name: EzBot — Enterprise Multi-Agent Knowledge Platform
items.description: An enterprise-scale Agentic RAG platform that routes requests to domain-specific AI agents (workspace, general Q&A, and debug analysis such as BSOD and IFWI). Built with FastAPI and PostgreSQL + pgvector for hybrid vector search over FAQ APIs, Confluence and SharePoint, with an Azure-hosted Claude LLM using tool-calling, orchestrator-based routing, and JWT/OAuth2-secured endpoints.
items.tagline: Orchestrator-routed multi-agent RAG over FAQ APIs, Confluence and SharePoint.

items.name: BSOD Copilot — AI Windows Crash Dump Analyzer
items.description: An MCP server (FastMCP + FastAPI) that wraps WinDbg/kd.exe as LLM-callable tools to automatically analyze Windows memory dumps. Encodes a kernel-debugging expert's knowledge into 19+ bugcheck-specific guides (0xA, 0x50, 0x133, 0x1CA…) covering root-cause patterns, IOMMU/DMA corruption, power-state failures and hardware faults.
items.tagline: WinDbg as LLM-callable tools, with a kernel expert's knowledge encoded as guides.

items.name: AgenticBot — Autonomous Validation Assistant
items.description: A ReAct-style autonomous agent that operates Linux validation environments via natural language. Features secure SSH command execution with intent classification, safety validation and human-in-the-loop approval, plus stateful sessions in MongoDB/Redis and an observability layer tracking token usage, latency and outcomes.
items.tagline: ReAct agent that drives Linux validation environments from natural language.

items.name: Multimodal RAG for Manufacturing Docs (Final Year Project)
items.description: A production-ready, fully on-premise multimodal RAG backend (FastAPI, Qdrant, MinIO, ColPali, Qwen2.5-VL) that answers questions across PDFs, images, tables and flowcharts. Uses HNSW indexing, metadata filtering and semantic reranking, improving retrieval from O(n) to ~O(log n).
items.tagline: Multimodal RAG across PDFs, images, tables and flowcharts — fully offline.
